title: Soy and sugarcane producers' tractor march against diesel-volume decrees
location: From Minero to Montero, northern Santa Cruz
organizer: Soybean and sugarcane producers of northern Santa Cruz; named coalition includes Concabol and other agro actors in search leads
participants_original: Around 300 tractors and about 2,000 soybean and sugarcane producers
threshold_50_evidence: The opened ANF report estimates about 2,000 producers and around 300 tractors in the march; this is clear evidence that the gathering exceeded 50, but the approximate report is retained without manufacturing precise participant bounds.

occurrence.summary: ANF reports producers staged the tractorazo, travelling from Minero to Montero and holding a mitin.

date.summary: ANF dated the event and its report to May 8, 2023.

location.summary: March route from Minero to Montero in northern Santa Cruz.

participants.summary: Around 2,000 producers; approximately 300 tractors. No derived min/max bounds.

demand.summary: Producers demanded repeal of DS 4910/4911, which restricted monthly diesel volumes during harvest. This is a demand for redress of domestic state policy; no claim about land use or fuel price is made.

state_response.summary: A vice minister said fuel supply was guaranteed and characterized the protest as disinformation; no accommodation or other coded response category is established.

notes: One opened ANF report provides occurrence, route, approximate threshold, and explicit state-policy demand. Other outlets surfaced in search results but remain search-only; they do not serve as independent body corroboration. No exact participant bounds or violence/response coding is inferred.
open_questions: Independent scientific review of occurrence, participant estimate and demand coding remains pending.
No source establishes protester violence or a coded state response.
